title: Barclay Woods
summary: Role-based community operations platform: one shared platform giving Residents, Management, and Vendors role-specific experiences over a common object model.
notes: Source screenshots are attached to the working conversation but were not located on this machine; no image files were written.
Filenames below are assigned and reserved. Drop original full-resolution, uncropped, unedited exports into public/portfolio/barclay-woods/ under these names.

assets.demonstrates: Single branded entry point with role-scoped navigation and the Resident/Management/Vendor context control present.
assets.interpretation: Establishes Barclay Woods as one product with one front door: the same platform that runs board operations and vendor service work presents the resident a calm editorial home surface, with navigation and capability already resolved to the current role.

assets.capture: Community Chat, Management View, full window, uncropped
assets.demonstrates: One communication surface under an explicit role context ('Viewing as Management' with a 'View as Resident' toggle), the global role switch, first-class Management announcement objects, pinning, and per-post authority actions (Edit / Unpin / Remove) beside resident-equivalent Appreciate / Reply.
assets.interpretation: The shared-platform / role-specific-experience model in a single frame: the same feed is the residents' notice board and management's announcement-and-moderation console; authority is capabilities layered on one object model, not a separate admin app.

assets.capture: Ticket Queue -> Service Types, Management, full window, uncropped
assets.demonstrates: Management operations console: community-wide workflow mode (Booking Only vs. Completion and Billing), configurable Service Type catalog with per-type Estimate / Appointment / Final Approval flags, triage tabs, and the rule that each ticket snapshots its requirements at submission and is never rewritten in flight.
assets.interpretation: Separation of a configurable workflow engine from the work it governs: configuration changes apply to future tickets only; every open ticket carries an immutable snapshot of the rules in force when it was raised.

assets.capture: Account -> Statement, Resident, full window, uncropped
assets.demonstrates: Household-scoped account (Unit 101 Household): current balance, due date, paid-to-date, Pay balance action, statement of open charges and payments received, with Payment history and Payment methods as sibling tabs.
assets.interpretation: Household-level financial visibility by resolving balance, due date, statement lines, payments received, and the payment action into one resident workflow, with the unit-owned charge as the single source of truth every view recalculates from.

assets.capture: Community Calendar, Resident, full window, uncropped
assets.demonstrates: One calendar carrying operational events (landscaping, gutter cleaning, board meeting) alongside social events; Month / Week views plus a 'Coming Up' agenda; resident Create Event and Calendar / Journal / My Submissions tabs.
assets.interpretation: Community coordination as a governed workflow, not a shared calendar file: residents submit events into a board-approval queue, management publishes onto one timeline, everyone reads the same schedule through the view that suits them.
